messages:
Jordan (CSM): Morning team — prepping BlueHarbor QBR (Wed 10am PT). Need final deck + action list by EOD Mon. High level asks below.

Jordan (CSM): 1) Account health snapshot (usage, NPS, incident history)
2) Onboarding status + blockers
3) Renewal/Risk slide with mitigation plan
4) Enablement plan: trainings, recordings, playbook links
5) Feedback capture: open asks and owner list

Priya (CS Ops): I'll take the health slide. Will pull MAU/seat trends and incident summary. Can someone confirm the NPS source? :eyes:

Mateo (AE): I'll own the renewal/risk slide. Current renewal sentiment: lukewarm — usage down 24% QoQ and exec sponsor hasn't re-engaged. Tentative risk score: 48%. I'll add mitigation steps. @Jordan can you share sponsor name?

Jordan (CSM): Sponsor is "Aisha Khan" (VP Product). Can you add a proposed sponsor touchpoint plan (ask: 30min exec sync + demo of recent perf wins)?

Mateo (AE): Yep. Proposed bullets: executive 1:1, feature highlight (low-latency routing), pilot uplift credit offer.

Sam (Enablement): I'll take onboarding slide + enablement plan. Running a 30-min live Q/A Tue 9am PT, and will publish the recording + short FAQ. Loom draft: https://loom.example.com/rec/abcd1234 (will finalize Wed).

Maya (SE): For onboarding blockers, here's the quick query I'll run for adoption metrics (prod-analytics):
```sql
SELECT week, active_users, avg_tokens_per_user, avg_latency_ms
FROM usage_metrics
WHERE account = 'blueharbor'
ORDER BY week DESC
LIMIT 12;
```
I'll paste results to the deck once done.

Priya (CS Ops): FYI calendar-bot created the QBR invite and included the execs. :spiral_calendar: Event link: https://calendar.example/evt/9876

Jordan (CSM): Action items (please mark done in thread):
```
- Priya: Health slide with MAU + incident notes (due Mon EOD)
- Maya: Paste adoption query results + top 3 feature usage charts (due Mon noon)
- Sam: Publish enablement recording + slide (due Mon EOD)
- Mateo: Renewal mitigation bullets + proposed sponsor cadence (due Mon EOD)
- Jordan: Draft exec speaking points and 15-min sponsor ask (due Mon EOD)
```

Mateo (AE): Quick ask — can we include a short screenshot of the recent perf dashboard? SEs, can you export a 1-slide snapshot?

Maya (SE): On it. Will export a PNG and drop in the deck: /drive/blueharbor/qbr/assets/perf-snap.png

Priya (CS Ops): Capturing feedback asks: performance, billing visibility, admin onboarding. I'll map owners on the feedback slide.

Jordan (CSM): Great. If we hit these, we can lower the risk score before execs meet. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

calendar-bot: QBR invite updated with deck upload reminder 24h before meeting.
